h1: Custom Water Repellent Apparel for Branding
metaTitle: Custom Water Repellent Apparel | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom water repellent apparel with your logo. Perfect for outdoor teams and rainy climates. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Water repellent apparel keeps your team dry and comfortable without the bulk of a rain jacket. Ideal for outdoor crews, event staff, or any team that works through light rain and drizzle. Choose from vests, jackets, and shell layers that accept full-color embroidery or screen printing. The DWR finish on styles like the Carhartt Duck Vest or Narvik Hybrid Jacket sheds moisture while maintaining breathability for active use.
heroAltText: Group of branded custom water repellent apparel including vests and jackets for outdoor workwear
